slides.title: Me calmly defending my unreasonable moving-company opinions:
slides.body: I will not be taking questions

slides.label: Opinion 1
slides.title: The cargo insurance renewal date is more important than my own birthday.
slides.body: My birthday doesn't get a truck pulled off a job.

slides.label: Opinion 2
slides.title: A truck registration in the glovebox from last year is not paperwork.

slides.label: Opinion 3
slides.title: "It renews automatically" is a theory, not a plan.

slides.label: Opinion 4
slides.title: If the only person who knows the license renewal date is the owner, nobody knows it.

slides.label: Closing statement
slides.title: I'm not being dramatic.
slides.body: I'm being renewed. Insurance, registrations, licenses, permits: every date written down somewhere you'll see it.
